name.local: 一般社団法人日本エンジェル投資家協会

aka: 日本エンジェル投資家協会

strategy.thesis: Industry body to develop Japan's angel-investment culture: build a network among angel investors, share information and know-how, develop angel-investment guidelines, and make policy recommendations to the government to strengthen Japan's angel-investment environment. Operates the 'Angel Link' founder-to-angel matching platform.

people.name: Toshiyuki Yamamoto (山本敏行)
people.role: Representative Director (代表理事); Chatwork founder; Power Angels CEO

application.how_to_apply: Recruits 'Angel members' (angel investors) and 'Partner members' (local governments, companies, startup-support organizations); membership free. Founders can reach angels via the Angel Link platform.

summary.en: A general incorporated association founded in 2023 by Chatwork founder Toshiyuki Yamamoto to grow Japan's thin angel-investing base. It networks angel investors, shares know-how, drafts angel-investment guidelines, lobbies government, and runs the free 'Angel Link' founder-to-angel matching platform (launched Jan 2025).
summary.local: Chatwork創業者・山本敏行が2023年に設立した一般社団法人。エンジェル投資家のネットワーク構築・情報共有、ガイドライン整備、政策提言を行い、起業家とエンジェルをつなぐ無料プラットフォーム『Angel Link』を運営する。

verification_notes: Founding date conflict: the Wikipedia infobox and an interview state 2023 (set here); a PR TIMES article body says '2019年11月'. The 2023 figure is corroborated by multiple sources and Wikipedia's structured data, so founded_year=2023 with this caveat. 'Angel Link' is a matching platform run by the association, not a separate org.

strategy.thesis: A community of angel investors centered on active company executives ('power angels') who back early-stage founders with capital plus hands-on, IPO-oriented mentoring. Originated as the 'SEVEN' angel-syndicate fund (a Japanese-law adaptation of US syndicate funds) aiming to build a Silicon-Valley-style ecosystem in Japan.

track_record.portfolio_count: ~85 startups (via the broader Power Angels / Yamamoto community)

application.how_to_apply: Membership limited to investors with substantial management experience; founders reach the community via Yamamoto / the Japan Angel Investor Association and the Angel Link platform.

summary.en: An angel-investor community led by Chatwork founder Toshiyuki Yamamoto (formerly named 'SEVEN', a Japanese-law angel-syndicate fund). Around 300 executive 'power angels' have backed roughly 85 startups, providing capital plus practical, IPO-oriented mentoring. Power Angels is the operating community behind Yamamoto's Japan Angel Investor Association.
summary.local: Chatwork創業者・山本敏行が率いる、現役経営者中心のエンジェル投資家コミュニティ（旧称『SEVEN』=日本法に合わせたエンジェルシンジケートファンド）。約300名のパワーエンジェルが約85社に投資し、資金提供に加え上場を見据えた実践的支援を行う。

strategy.thesis: Syndicate-style fund where ~10 prominent founder-angels ('scouters') each independently source deals from their own allocation (no veto from others). Returns split LPs 50% / sourcing scouter 40% / remaining scouters 10%; scouters contribute no personal capital. Aim: maximize angels' know-how and influence across the startup ecosystem and build a PayPal-Mafia-style knowledge network in Japan.

application.how_to_apply: Founders are sourced directly by individual scouter-angels from their personal networks; no public open application.

summary.en: A 2018 syndicate-style fund of ~300M yen organized by ten prominent founder-angels (incl. Candle, Fablic, Spotlight, Coach United and Eureka founders). Each 'scouter' independently deploys part of the fund with no veto from peers; returns split 50/40/10 between LPs, the sourcing scouter and the rest. Built to circulate startup know-how and seed a PayPal-Mafia-style network in Japan.
summary.local: Candle代表・金靖征が発起人となり、著名な起業家出身エンジェル10名が参画する2018年組成の約3億円のシンジケート型ファンド。各『スカウター』が拒否権なしで独立に投資し、リターンはLP50%・提案スカウター40%・他9名10%で分配。スタートアップの知の流通を狙う。

name.local: 京都エンジェルファンド

aka: 京大認定ファンド (Kyoto University certified fund)

strategy.thesis: A Kyoto-University-certified angel fund in which experienced founder-angels back early-stage startups founded (typically within 5 years) by Kyoto University students/alumni, aiming for IPO-class outcomes. Senior entrepreneurs support the next generation.

program.eligibility: Companies founded within ~5 years, primarily by Kyoto University current/former students or graduates; ~1 month review.

people.name: Yasumasa Yamamoto (山本康正)
people.role: Representative Director; Kyoto University specially-appointed associate professor

application.how_to_apply: Apply via the Kyoto Angel Fund website; ~1 month selection. Targets Kyoto University-affiliated founders.

summary.en: A Kyoto-University-certified angel fund (Fund 1 ~¥100M, est. Oct 2020) in which senior founder-angels back early-stage startups by Kyoto University students/alumni, with checks of ¥1–50M and IPO-class ambitions. Ten prominent founder-investors (incl. SHIFT, Money Forward, gumi leaders) act as supporters; portfolio includes AironWorks, DataGrid, Bitkey and Regional Fish.
summary.local: 京都大学認定のエンジェルファンド（1号は約1億円、2020年10月設立）。先輩起業家エンジェルが京大の学生・卒業生による創業5年以内のスタートアップに1件100万〜5000万円を投資。AironWorks、DataGrid、Bitkey、Regional Fish などに出資。

sources.supports: Fund size, founding date, check size, eligibility, representative, portfolio companies

name.local: 京都エンジェルコミュニティ

strategy.thesis: An angel network operated by the public Kyoto Industrial Support Organization 21, connecting 'angel advisors' (Kyoto manufacturing-company executives and Kyoto-linked angel investors) with seed/early-stage deep-tech startups in Kyoto Prefecture, providing management advice, mentoring and financial support.

program.eligibility: Seed/early-stage deep-tech startups primarily in Kyoto Prefecture; ~4 networking meetings per year.

application.how_to_apply: Apply through the Kyoto Industrial Support Organization 21 (KKC) angel-community program.

summary.en: An angel network run by the public-interest Kyoto Industrial Support Organization 21 that matches 'angel advisors' (Kyoto manufacturing executives and Kyoto-linked angels) with seed/early-stage deep-tech startups in Kyoto, offering mentoring, management advice and financial support, with around four exchange meetings a year.
summary.local: 公益財団法人京都産業21が運営するエンジェルネットワーク。京都を代表するものづくり企業経営者や京都ゆかりのエンジェル投資家からなる『エンジェルアドバイザー』が、京都府内のシード・アーリー期ディープテック型スタートアップに経営アドバイス・メンタリング・資金支援を行う。年4回程度の交流会を開催。

strategy.thesis: An angel syndicate of full-time professionals (lawyers, ex-bankers, entrepreneurs, hedge-fund and consulting backgrounds) backing seed-to-early-stage companies based in, connected to, or entering Japan — with a focus on food/beverage, biotech and gamification.

application.how_to_apply: Reach out via Yakumi's site / network; syndicate co-invests alongside other investors.

summary.en: A Tokyo-based angel syndicate of full-time professionals (incl. a New York lawyer, ex-bankers, a hedge-fund manager and entrepreneurs) backing seed-to-early-stage startups based in, connected to, or entering Japan, with a focus on food/beverage, biotech and gamification. Notable investments include Finless Foods, PlayCo and Bokksu.
summary.local: 東京拠点のエンジェルシンジケート。ニューヨークの弁護士、元銀行員、ヘッジファンドマネージャー、起業家らフルタイムのプロが集まり、日本に関わる/参入するシード〜アーリー期スタートアップに投資。食品・バイオ・ゲーミフィケーション分野に注力し、Finless Foods、PlayCo、Bokksu などに出資。

strategy.thesis: A community/network connecting founders aiming to become unicorns with angel investors. Angels display portfolios and provide mentorship; founders send funding consultations directly. Real-name participation (Facebook-authenticated).

application.how_to_apply: Register (Facebook-authenticated) and message angel investors directly through the platform.

summary.en: A Japanese angel-investor community (operated by WEIN Group) that connects unicorn-aspiring founders with angel investors. Angels publish portfolios and mentor founders who reach out directly; participation is real-name (Facebook-authenticated).
summary.local: WEIN Groupが運営する、ユニコーンを目指す起業家とエンジェル投資家をつなぐコミュニティ。エンジェルがポートフォリオを公開し、起業家が直接出資相談を送る、Facebook認証による実名制のネットワーク。

strategy.thesis: An angel network launched by VC firm ANRI to match founding-stage startups with a curated group of founder-angels for mentoring on business and capital strategy. ANRI screened applications and made introductions; it took no investment rights or obligations in the startups.

program.eligibility: Founding/early-stage startups seeking mentoring on business and capital strategy; screened by ANRI.

application.how_to_apply: Historically: startups applied to ANRI, which screened and introduced qualifying teams to angels. No longer actively promoted.

summary.en: An angel network launched in Feb 2016 by VC firm ANRI to match founding-stage startups with seven founder-angels (incl. co-founders of DeNA, Gunosy, Mercari, FreakOut and Eureka) for mentoring on business and capital strategy. ANRI screened applicants and made introductions without taking investment rights. It appears no longer actively run.
summary.local: VCのANRIが2016年2月に立ち上げたエンジェルネットワーク。DeNA・Gunosy・メルカリ・FreakOut・Eurekaなどの創業者7名のエンジェルと創業期スタートアップをマッチングし、事業・資本戦略のメンタリングを提供。ANRIが審査・紹介を行い投資の権利義務は負わない仕組みだったが、現在は積極運用されていない模様。
